main_text.p: laudo! Ita enim fas eft! ita contemnere o- portet contemtum iflum! Vt tandem intelligas ( fub-inferebam ego ) quid velim, declarabo me exem- plo, è propinquo petito. Poftquam per integrum penè quinquennium verfatus fum in opere τῶν χρησμῶν θεῶν πολλογικῶν, & aliquam-mul- ta vidi aliis invifa : aufus fum A- nimadverfiones has, quas vides, meditari in COMITEM MON- TANUM de Morbo, eique con- tigua fcripram, ut publici juris fa- ciam, fi quâ fata finant. Ex his in- telligas GALENVM quidem in hoc ipfo negotio in multis mari- cum effe : MONTANVS autem, interpretem ipfius, in plerifque fuccubuiffe oneri. Illum quidem facilè excufabit defultorius fcri- bendi modus, Plinio non diffimi- lis, quem necipfe deprecatur, fa- miliarem quippe Afiaticis omni- bus: hunc autem, poft 25 annorum decurfum, & quidem in otio ruftis cano,

page.notes: Marginal notes at the right edge are cut off and largely illegible; only fragments such as "cano", "Gal", "Hipp" are faintly visible and were not transcribed. Greek words transcribed as best read. Several words in the first lines are doubtful.
